title: Hotfix 1.26.1
body:
# Hotfix 1.26.1

Hello Raiders!

A hotfix has been released to fix a critical issue that had disabled Crossplay, along with a handful of crash fixes and a repair for a problem affecting color variants on certain backpacks. Additional fixes for more common crashes are still being worked on.

* Fixed an issue where changing the crossplay setting caused Crossplay to be toggled off across all platforms.

* Patched several of the more frequent causes of crashes.

* Fixed an issue that made certain backpacks missing some of their color variations.

Thanks for the fast feedback! Keep scouring the coast!
